name: DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Bars
description: Renders a bar chart as an SVG data URI showing measure values across an axis

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Optional series color. Defaults to theme color

parameters.name: minMarkColor
parameters.description: Optional: The hex color for the minimum value bar

parameters.name: maxMarkColor
parameters.description: Optional: The hex color for the maximum value bar

parameters.name: showAxis
parameters.description: Optional axis toggle. Defaults to FALSE

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Viz.Bars' =
		(
			axisRef: ANYREF EXPR,
			measureRef: NUMERIC EXPR,
			color: STRING = BLANK(),
			minMarkColor: STRING = BLANK(),
			maxMarkColor: STRING = BLANK(),
			showAxis: BOOLEAN = FALSE(),
			width: INT64 = 120,
			height: INT64 = 48
		) =>

			VAR _Marks =
				DaxLib.SVG.Compound.Bars(
					0, 
                    0, 
                    width, 
                    height,
					axisRef,
                    measureRef,
					color, 
                    minMarkColor, 
                    maxMarkColor, 
                    showAxis
				)

			RETURN
				IF( NOT ISBLANK( _Marks ), DaxLib.SVG.SVG( "100%", "100%", _Marks, "0 0 " & width & " " & height ) )
